# Card tokenization request validation (PAY-1217)

Scope: validate inbound JSON for POST /v2/tokens before it is tokenized. validator.validate(payload) returns a list of error strings (empty list = valid).

## Fields
- card.number: PAN. Digits only after stripping spaces and hyphens, 13-19 digits, must pass Luhn.
- card.expiry: MM/YYYY string. Must not be a past month. Must be within 10 years of today.
- card.cvv: allowed ONLY when token_policy.persist is false (transient authorization). If persist is true, any cvv key anywhere in the payload is an error.
- card.billing.address: object. line1 required (1-120 chars), city required, postal_code optional (alphanumeric, space, hyphen), country required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase.
- metadata: flat object. Max 20 keys, keys <= 40 chars, values must be string, number, or bool. No nested objects or arrays.
- token_policy: {persist: bool, ttl_days: int 1-365 or null, scope: one of 'payments', 'payouts', 'recurring'}.

## General
- Max nesting depth: 6 levels of objects/arrays.
- Strings are NFKC-normalized before checks. Reject strings containing control characters.
- null on a required field is an error. Empty string on a required field is an error. Optional fields may be null.
- Unknown top-level keys are an error.
- Never raise on malformed input. Return errors.

## Legacy
v1 accepted card.pan. Migrated in PAY-1102 (closed). Do not reintroduce.
